decisions.reason: As a training offer with its own page over two years, it likely supports machine sales and the installed base, so a mature Mittelstand machinery firm would usually retain it unless uptake is clearly weak.
A fourth rotary axis is a plausible complementary accessory for CNC customers, and despite lighter website prominence it is still strategically adjacent enough to keep on the market.
Hybrid additive post-processing looks like a more experimental niche extension that was only briefly mentioned, so management would be relatively likely to withdraw it if demand and fit were limited.
A high-speed CNC milling machine presented on its own page is likely a core capital product, and a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually continue backing such a recent strategic launch.
An automatic tool change system is a valuable automation feature closely tied to the firm’s machinery offering, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
